description: Deterministic seed Blender project for Spec 001. Contains exactly one object, a Cube at the world origin, so every integration and E2E run starts from a known state (Cube X = 0). Generated from scratch by generate_seed_project.py; never hand-edited.
spec_001_scenario: Move Cube 50 cm to the right -> Cube X = 0.50 m

determinism.note: Blender embeds its version and file paths in the .blend container, so the binary is not byte-for-byte reproducible and no attempt is made to force that. What is guaranteed reproducible is the SCENE STATE relevant to Spec 001: the object list, each object's name, stable object_id, world position, rotation, scale, dimensions, and the scene unit configuration. verify_scene_digest() compares exactly those.
